v.credibility: Management’s track record shows several unverified or unmet promises, indicating limited credibility.

bull.point: Revenue climbed from ₹239,986 Cr (Dec 2024) to ₹330,601 Cr (Sep 2026), a 38% increase.
EBITDA rose to ₹56,616 Cr in Q2 FY27, reflecting improving earnings.
Management highlighted strong polyester chain margins (+33%) and ethane price advantage, supporting future profitability.

bear.point: Q2‑Q3 FY26 revenue growth hit only 6‑10%, missing the 13‑14% target.
Key guidance on ethane ship delivery and Jio IPO lacks any verification, suggesting over‑optimism.
Stated EBITDA margins of 56.2%/51.8% are far above the reported ~15‑18% margins, indicating unrealistic goals.
